decision: 5 second time penalty imposed after the Sprint. (5 seconds added to elapsed Sprint time). 2 penalty points (total of 6 for the 12 month period).
event_name: Time 19:17 2022 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 November 2022 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 34 and 35) and heard from the drivers and the team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Pit straight incident between cars 31 and 14.
offence: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 14 (Fernando Alonso), the driver of Car 31 (Esteban Ocon), the team representative and have reviewed video and telemetry evidence. Alonso started a pass on car 31 at turn 15. The team noted that Ocon was unusually slow because of the aero damage due to the incident at turn 4, however the Stewards determined via telemetry that Ocon was at similar speeds to other cars at the same point on the track that were not in a tow. Alonso, however, was significantly faster as he had the tow, and – as he admitted in the hearing – slightly misjudged the time to pull out and struck Ocon from behind, his front wing striking Ocon's rear tyre. The Stewards found that Alonso was wholly at fault for the collision, which at those speeds and at that location on the track was dangerous.
stewards: found that Alonso was wholly at fault for the collision
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 14 Collision With Car 31
